title: MIRRORSTORIES: Reflecting Diversity through Personalized Narrative Generation with Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not present any findings specifically related to religion. 'Jewish' was included as one of 123 possible values for the 'Ethnicity' category, but the paper does not analyze the model's performance on this or any other ethnoreligious identity separately.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the ability of LLMs to incorporate personal identity traits into stories. One of the identity traits listed under the 'Ethnicity' category was 'Jewish', which can be considered an ethnoreligious identity. However, religion was not a primary category of analysis, and there was no specific measurement of religious bias, knowledge, or stereotypes.
